Industry solutions

Manufacturing training

For plants and factories where supervisors are the vital link between management goals and shop-floor reality.

Talk to us about manufacturing trainingSee the programmes

Why it matters

People performance in manufacturing

On the shop floor, supervisors decide whether plans become results. Most were promoted because they were the best at the technical work — but leading a shift, running a briefing, handling conflict and getting ownership from a team are very different skills.

Our manufacturing programmes are practical, activity-based and built around real plant situations. We work with supervisors, line leaders and shop-floor teams in the language and style that suits them, so the skills are easy to apply from the very next shift.

Challenges we often solve

  • Supervisors promoted for technical skill, not people skills
  • Shift handovers and briefings that miss key information
  • Low ownership and blame between departments
  • Conflicts between workers and supervisors that affect output
  • Safety and quality rules followed only when someone is watching

Success story

Turning technical supervisors into people leaders

Sample

Challenge: Shift supervisors were technically excellent but struggled with communication, conflict and ownership on the shop floor.

Approach: Role plays on briefing and debriefing, conflict scenarios drawn from the plant itself, and 30-day workplace action plans.

Outcome: Designed to lift the quality of shift handovers and supervisor ownership, tracked through plant-head feedback.

How we deliver it

Every programme follows the proven 16Dimensions six-step methodology.

  1. 01

    Understand

    We start with your business need and the real challenges your people face.

  2. 02

    Assess

    We map current behaviours, capabilities and the gaps that matter most.

  3. 03

    Customise

    We design learning around your industry, roles and workplace scenarios.

  4. 04

    Engage

    Participants learn by doing — role plays, discussion and live case studies.

  5. 05

    Apply

    Everyone leaves with clear action points to practise back on the job.

  6. 06

    Measure

    We review feedback, assessments and the business indicators agreed with you.

FAQs

Questions about manufacturing training

Something else you'd like to know? We're happy to talk it through.

Ask a question
Can the training be delivered in Tamil or a mix of languages?

Yes. For shop-floor and supervisor groups we deliver in the language participants are most comfortable with, including Tamil and English, so the focus stays on the skills rather than the vocabulary.

Can you train at our plant, around shift timings?

Yes. We regularly run sessions on-site and plan the schedule around your shifts, including shorter sessions that fit before or after a shift.

Do you cover PoSH for factory employees?

Yes. We run PoSH awareness for employees and supervisors in simple, relatable language, and support the Internal Committee with capability building and external member services.
